pick.name: Excalidraw (+ official MCP)
pick.what: Hand-drawn style whiteboard; official MCP lets Claude draw scenes
pick.why: Free, MIT, and the official hosted MCP (mcp.excalidraw.com) lets Claude create diagrams directly.
pick.free_limits: excalidraw.com free; Excalidraw+ free tier 1 scene, 10 AI requests/day; Plus $6/user/mo

alts.name: draw.io Desktop
alts.what: Precise boxes-and-arrows diagramming, offline Windows app
alts.why: Best for exact network/cloud architecture diagrams and client .vsdx-like work.

alts.name: tldraw.com
alts.why: Nice free app; SDK embedding in your product needs a licence key (Hobby non-commercial or paid).
alts.free_limits: App free; SDK production use requires licence

decision: Excalidraw is free, open and Claude-drivable through its official MCP. Use draw.io when precision matters more than speed.

verify.note: excalidraw-mcp repo exists (MIT, remote https://mcp.excalidraw.com); @excalidraw/excalidraw 0.18.1 (2026-04-20); Excalidraw+ free 1 scene / 10 AI requests a day, Plus $6.
